 Tell retailers in the Toxic Hall of Shame it’s past time to restrict harmful chemicals and plastics!
 The 2026 Retailer Report Card marks 10 years of evaluating retailers on their efforts to adopt and implement comprehensive chemical policies.
 But 16 companies earned failing grades for their efforts to address toxic chemicals and plastics in their products and packaging. These include Trader Joe’s, McDonald’s, and Sherwin-Williams, as well as newly evaluated retailers Wayfair and Williams-Sonoma.
 Tell the retailers in the “Toxic Hall of Shame” to step up and protect our health from toxic chemicals and plastics!
